rows.text: The key to piloting Yuna, Hope of Spira is understanding its core engine: Yuna protects enchantment creatures with trample, lifelink, and ward 2, and reanimates any enchantment from your graveyard to the battlefield every end step, establishing unbreakable board presence and lifegain.

This is a Bracket 3 build running three Game Changers: Smothering Tithe, Teferi's Protection, Enlightened Tutor. It contains zero mass land denial and focuses on high-synergy board development, interactive answers, and an inevitable endgame clock.
